title: The Republican Exception: Puerto Rico Delivers the Nation's Best Medicare Advantage Quality on the Nation's Worst Funding
description: Medicare Advantage covers 96% of Puerto Rico's Medicare population, yet a hidden federal formula prices the island off a tiny fee-for-service remnant - mostly veterans and low utilizers. The inside story of the campaign that turned that statistical absurdity into a bipartisan administrative fix, and the fourteen House Republicans, led by physician Rep. Greg Murphy, who demanded the 0.70 benchmark floor.
